# Where Big Fish

> Where Big Fish is a free, real-time multiplayer fishing game that runs in any modern web browser — no download or install. Cast your line, win a reel minigame, collect fish of every rarity, and climb a live leaderboard with other players fishing the same lake.

## Key facts

- Type: free-to-play, browser-based, real-time multiplayer fishing game.
- Platform: desktop web browser. No download, install, or account required.
- Website: https://wherebigfish.com/
- Core loop: cast your line → win the reel minigame → land the fish → score points → climb the live leaderboard.
- Fish: 16 species across common, uncommon, rare, and legendary tiers, from the common Minnow, Silver Carp, and Catfish to the legendary Golden Arowana and Baby Shark, plus a few quirky finds (Old Boot, Soggy Bread, Vicent's Wallet).
- Ocean species (Butterfish, Mackerel, Bluefin Tuna, Baby Shark) appear only in the East Sea; other species live in lakes and the river.

## How to play

1. Enter a name, pick a character, and press Play to join a lake.
2. Walk to a lake, river, or sea shore with WASD or the arrow keys.
3. Hold the mouse to charge power, then release to cast toward the cursor.
4. When a fish bites, the reel minigame opens: hold the mouse to lift the green catch zone and keep the moving fish inside it.
5. Keep the fish in the zone to fill the progress bar and land it. Rarer and heavier fish score more points and climb the leaderboard faster.
